channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay by Windsor
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay by Windsor (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay by Windsor: The record's summary no longer says EVIVA was The Integral Group's brand (neither cited source, the GID release or the Assessor row, names Integral Group) and now names the buyer as GID, the name the release uses, not 'GID Real Estate'. The site notes and an earlier change entry no longer call 360 Berry a condo complex: the Assessor classes it as an apartment building of 15 or more units. The aerial photo's credit no longer says it was taken from a departing flight, which its Commons page does not say; the name Alfred Twu comes from the author's Commons user page.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay by Windsor: Correction to a 2026-09-19 finding: 'Mission Bay by Windsor' (360 Berry St) and Edgewater (355 Berry St) had been judged the same building from a 99.6% footprint-overlap check, and Windsor was never added as its own record. They are two separate buildings, confirmed via DataSF Assessor parcels (distinct blklots: 8707003 for Edgewater, 8704004 for Windsor). This also explains a piece briefly added to Edgewater's record on 2026-09-20 as an unexplained 'open-land strip along I-280': it was 96.7% the previously untracked Windsor parcel. That piece was removed from Edgewater, and Windsor was added as its own parcel-backed record (blklot 8704004). Plan label N4-3 is Windsor; N4A-3 is Edgewater.
